URST 200.title: Cities
URST 200.description: An interdisciplinary introduction to the city in the context of contemporary globalization. Analysis of urban patterns and processes from the theoretical perspectives of various disciplines and methodologies.

URST 352.title: Urbanization in the Global South
URST 352.description: The role of cities in development and global capital circulation, and urban politics with emphasis on regions in Latin America, Africa, and Asia.

URST 400.title: Seminar in Urban Studies
URST 400.description: A seminar for senior students who wish to explore some common topics of importance to urban studies from the viewpoints of several disciplines. Restricted to students with fourth-year standing or higher.

URST 450.title: Urban Research
URST 450.description: Historical, legal, and quantitative analysis of urban research. Emphasis on spatial, racial, and political dynamics of urban inequality. Restricted to students with fourth-year standing or higher.

URST 451.title: Urban Studies Capstone I
URST 451.description: Formulation of key elements of urban studies theory, concepts, and methods to a community-engaged urban challenge.
URST 451.prerequisiteText: One of GEOG_V 250, URST_V 200 and all of PLAN_V 211, PLAN_V 231, GEOG_V 371

URST 452.title: Urban Studies Capstone II
URST 452.description: Application of key elements of urban studies theory, concepts, and methods to a community-engaged urban challenge. Restricted to students with fourth-year standing or higher.
